title: Flat second coefficient extension and raw cohomological counits
statement: Let R, A, B, Bp, D be commutative rings with R-algebras A, B, Bp, a B-algebra structure on Bp and IsScalarTower R B Bp; let D have algebra structures over A tensor_R B and A tensor_R Bp. Assume derived categories for R-, B-, and Bp-modules and flatness of B to Bp. Fix an integer i, a complex Q of A-modules and models L and K of [def-pc-base-derived-tensor-cohomology-model] for coefficients B and Bp. Put T=Res_R Q, P=B tensor_R T, Pp=Bp tensor_R T, U=Res_B and X=Qh(T). Let c and cp be homology of L.counit and K.counit at T, followed by the derived/homotopy/complex homology factorization isomorphisms, with targets H^i(P) and H^i(Pp). Put d=(flatDerivedHomologyIso B Bp)^(-1) at L.derived(X), followed by H^i(secondLocalizationDerivedMap(X)), using the constructions of [lem-pc-second-localization-map]. Every B-linear chain map chi:P to U(Pp) sending b tensor x to image(b) tensor x satisfies c;H^i(chi)=adj_B_Bp(d;cp);s_Pp^(-1), where adj is extension/restriction adjunction on modules and s_Pp:H^i(U(Pp)) to U(H^i(Pp)) is exact-restriction homology. This statement does not involve either model ordinaryIso, cohomologyIso, comparison or localizedComparison.

source.place: Tag 06Y6, lemma-derived-base-change: derived scalar-extension associativity and its counit

proof.text: Install K.universal and apply Functor.leftDerived_fac_app to secondLocalizationDerivedMap. Evaluate at qR(T). The ordinary associator is the complex map epsilon induced by extendScalarsComp inverse and the scalar-tower equality. The quotient of epsilon is exactly the homotopy associator component, so the derived counit equation is obtained by the universal lift factorization.

The private flat_homology_factor computes flatDerivedHomologyIso inverse at the quotient of any ordinary B-complex. Expand mapDerivedCategoryFactorsh and homologyFunctorFactorsh at quotient objects; cancel the homotopy homology factors. Naturality along quotientCompQhIso reduces to DerivedCategory.Q. Unfold the actual localization lift defining flatDerivedHomologyIso and use Localization.liftNatTrans_app. Cancel the derived extension and homology factorization isomorphisms. Apply this computation to P, naturality to L.counit, and homology factorization naturality to epsilon. This proves d followed by cp equals E.map(c) followed by inverse exact-extension homology comparison and homology(epsilon).

The private adjoint_homology proves compatibility of exact homology with adjoint chain maps directly using ShortComplex.LeftHomologyMapData. Transpose the cycle and homology maps of the extended source; adjunction naturality proves the inclusion, differential and projection equations. The homology-data comparison isomorphisms identify the resulting maps with the canonical homology maps. To identify chi with the transpose of epsilon, apply ExtendScalars.hom_ext in each degree, so only 1 tensor x is needed. Use hchi at b=1, extendScalarsComp_hom_app_one_tmul, inverse cancellation, and equality transport of the algebra map. Transpose the previous equation using homEquiv_naturality_left and adjoint_homology; cancel the exact-restriction homology isomorphism. All three private helpers are completely proved, with no new holes or hypotheses. Zero complexes, zero rings and identity coefficient extensions are handled by the same identities.

from.place: Affine localization identity: the raw universal-counit square under flat second coefficient extension, before transporting to ordinary tensor-algebra models.

lean.statement:
theorem secondLocalization_raw_counit_square
    (hflat : (algebraMap B Bp).Flat) (i : ℤ)
    (Q : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ)
    (L : ModuleCat.BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R A B Q D)
    (K : ModuleCat.BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R A Bp Q D) :
    let T := ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars (algebraMap R A)).mapHomologicalComplex
      (.up ℤ)).obj Q
    let P := ((ModuleCat.extendScalars (algebraMap R B)).mapHomologicalComplex
      (.up ℤ)).obj T
    let Pp := ((ModuleCat.extendScalars (algebraMap R Bp)).mapHomologicalComplex
      (.up ℤ)).obj T
    let U := ModuleCat.restrictScalars (algebraMap B Bp)
    let qR := HomotopyCategory.quotient (ModuleCat.{u} R) (.up ℤ)
    let qB := HomotopyCategory.quotient (ModuleCat.{u} B) (.up ℤ)
    let qBp := HomotopyCategory.quotient (ModuleCat.{u} Bp) (.up ℤ)
    let H := DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} B) i
    let Hp := DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} Bp) i
    let X := DerivedCategory.Qh.obj (qR.obj T)
    let c := H.map (L.counit.app (qR.obj T)) ≫
      (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctorFactorsh (ModuleCat.{u} B) i).hom.app (qB.obj P) ≫
      (HomotopyCategory.homologyFunctorFactors (ModuleCat.{u} B) (.up ℤ) i).hom.app P
    let cp := Hp.map (K.counit.app (qR.obj T)) ≫
      (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctorFactorsh (ModuleCat.{u} Bp) i).hom.app (qBp.obj Pp) ≫
      (HomotopyCategory.homologyFunctorFactors (ModuleCat.{u} Bp) (.up ℤ) i).hom.app Pp
    letI := ModuleCat.preservesFiniteLimits_extendScalars_of_flat hflat
    let d := (flatDerivedHomologyIso B Bp hflat i).inv.app (L.derived.obj X) ≫
      Hp.map ((secondLocalizationDerivedMap R A B Bp D hflat Q L K).app X)
    ∀ (χ : P ⟶ (U.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Pp)
      (_hχ : ∀ (j : ℤ) (b : B) (x : Q.X j),
        χ.f j (b ⊗ₜ[R,algebraMap R B] (show T.X j from x)) =
          algebraMap B Bp b ⊗ₜ[R,algebraMap R Bp] (show T.X j from x)),
      c ≫ HomologicalComplex.homologyMap χ i =
        (ModuleCat.extendRestrictScalarsAdj (algebraMap B Bp)).homEquiv _ _ (d ≫ cp) ≫
          ((Pp.sc i).mapHomologyIso U).inv
